content: Sneha Roy and insurance agent Vikram Patel discuss the upcoming expiration and renewal of health policy HP-4478 on September 30, 2026. Vikram confirms that the renewal documents have been sent with a 5% loyalty discount applied, resulting in a new monthly premium of $199.50. Sneha agrees to the terms and confirms no further action or signature is required, as the electronic signature via email is sufficient.

action_items: Vikram Patel to update the system regarding the policy renewal
